title: Willie's serious character and how musicians miss him
summary: Willie never laughed and thought only of music; musicians still tell her they miss him.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
story.community_name: Bix Beiderbecke: hearing, copying and remembering him

blocks.x: No, I don't know who he used to be. He come get his horn going out, I wouldn't know where he's going. You just tell him I'm going to play, Bella, and that's all. He didn't have much to say. He was unconcerned. You never see him laugh. He was always, uh, in earnest. You know what he had to do. Like some of them, they would laugh. He never did much, wasn't much, when he laughed it would be a surprise. I said, Lord, the man don't even laugh to myself. He never knew he was in earnest with that horn. And when somebody would hire him and all that was his mind on that. He knew he was making his, well, making his living. You couldn't blame him for that, could you? He was making his living. I used to look at him. His mama told me, said, Bella, he'll never laugh. And he'll sit down and he'll sit down and he wouldn't have hardly, nothing to say. And sometimes I say, Willie, so and so. He said, uh-huh, that's all. He wouldn't have nothing to say to you? I used to look at him. I said, well, what kind of man is he? His mama said, Bella, he's done by nothing but that music. She told me, she said, you're wasting time talking to Willie. I said, Willie, talking about that music. And when they say music, he's gone.

A person interested in anything, you know how they is. Everybody's like that. He sure they like music. And he's missing, too, because they say so. They tell me. Lots of people tell me. I met a man the other day. He said, y'all can see. When they see the bands and I said, Lord, for Willie, sure he's missing this bell. He said, we can tell. And yet, they had a parade a couple of months ago, it was, and I seen some of them. He was on the corner and I seen some of the men on that side, and I went down there where they was. They talked to them, some of them. And they said, oh, Bella, look a corner. He said, Bella, we showed him Miss Willie. I said, y'all miss him? I said, well, I miss him, too. He said, yeah, well, we miss Willie. Yes, indeed. And when they go to play, he wouldn't know how to come get him. Don't you think they would? Come on, Willie, you go and say, yeah, I'm coming.
